step1_analysis.description: A symmetrical current-mirror OTA with cascoded output stages and an integrated self-biasing network. It serves as the high-gain error amplifier in the feedback loop of the current-mode DC-DC converter.

paper_reference.title: A Monolithic Current-Mode CMOS DC–DC Converter With On-Chip Current-Sensing Technique

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the OTA.

paper_reported.value: 20 dB (Note: likely refers to loop gain or sensor gain, not OTA open-loop gain)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm * Rout. Gm = gm1 = 70uS (assuming 10uA tail current). Rout = (gm12*ro14*ro12) || (gm10*ro8*ro10) ~= 200 MOhm. Gain = 70uS * 200MOhm = 14000 V/V = 83 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using sky130 parameters for 1.8V, assuming a 10uA reference bias current. Cascoded outputs provide very high output resistance.

Unity_Gain_Frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

paper_reported.value: 300 kHz - 1 MHz (Converter switching frequency, OTA UGF must be >10x higher)

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = Gm / (2 * pi * CL). With Gm = 70uS and CL = 1pF, UGF = 70uS / (2 * pi * 1pF) = 11.1 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance (CL) and the bias current setting Gm.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity gain frequency, indicating closed-loop stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is at the output node. Non-dominant poles are at the current mirrors (~1.3 GHz). Since UGF (11 MHz) << f_nd, phase shift from non-dominant poles is minimal.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High phase margin is expected due to the single-stage nature of the OTA (dominant pole at output) and fast internal current mirrors.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the OTA and its bias circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = Ibias (10uA) + I_bias_mirrors (20uA) + I_tail (10uA) + I_out_branches (10uA) = 50uA. Power = 50uA * 1.8V = 90uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a 10uA reference current and 1:1 mirror ratios throughout the symmetrical OTA structure.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point for power consumption, and performs AC analysis to determine open-loop DC gain, unity gain frequency, and phase margin. Uses a large inductor/capacitor feedback network to stabilize the DC operating point while breaking the loop for AC analysis.
